fields.label: Supervisor
fields.help_text: The supervisor who oversaw this audit. They review it and sign it off.

fields.label: Date of the audit
fields.help_text: When you measured practice against the standard, not when this form is completed.

fields.label: Standard audited against
fields.help_text: The agreed standard or guideline, and where it comes from.

fields.label: Sample
fields.help_text: What was measured: which cases, records or episodes, how many, and over what period. No patient names or record numbers.

fields.label: Findings
fields.help_text: How practice compared with the standard.

fields.label: Change made
fields.help_text: What was changed in response to the findings.

fields.label: Re-audit date
fields.help_text: When practice was, or will be, measured again after the change.

fields.label: Audit report (link)
fields.help_text: A link to the full report where your department keeps it, starting https://. Wombat does not store attached files.

fields.label: Supervisor comments
fields.help_text: Your review of the audit and its report. A clinical audit is not rated.
